# libID

> Primitives and protocols for new economies built around familiar social identities.

libID is an open protocol and software project for verifying control of existing
social accounts and using those identities in applications on verifiable ledgers.
The specifications describe identity ceremonies, browser transport, and services.
Read each specification's status and assumptions before treating it as implemented.

## Main materials

- [Home](https://lib.id/): Project overview.
- [Documentation](https://lib.id/docs/): Introduction; currently under construction.
- [Protocol specification](https://lib.id/specs/): Required entry point and links to the normative chapters.
- [Common ceremony rules](https://lib.id/specs/ceremony-common/): Shared identity-ceremony constructions and invariants.
- [Identity-platform ceremonies](https://lib.id/specs/platform-ceremonies/): Google, X, and GitHub ceremony profiles.
- [Browser transport](https://lib.id/specs/popup-transport/): Connections between applications and popup documents.
- [Source code](https://github.com/libid-org/libID): Code, specifications, licenses, and links to related repositories.
- [handles.link](https://handles.link/): Separate application using libID.
